meta.description: A 5x5 grid navigation task. An agent moves UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT from a start cell to a GOAL cell; stepping on a FIRE cell fails the episode. Layouts have 3 fires placed so a fire-free path exists (Manhattan(start,goal) >= 4). Grounds DISTIL failure analysis + prescribed corridor layouts. Coordinates are (row, col), origin top-left, cells in [0..4]^2.

properties.reach: episode succeeds when the agent steps onto it

properties.effect: stepping on a fire terminates the episode as a FAILURE

properties.description: The policy steers away from the goal / toward a dead pocket, increasing distance-to-goal.
The policy walks the agent onto a fire cell, terminating in failure.
The policy repeatedly picks a move blocked by the boundary, oscillating without progress.
Horizon reached without arriving at the goal (hesitation / looping).
moving from the start region toward the goal quadrant
threading the fire-free corridor between hazards
a branch cell where two routes are equally optimal (multimodal choice)

reasoning_implications.wrong_direction: Prescribe a start cell mid-corridor so the demo teaches the correct heading toward the goal quadrant.
reasoning_implications.hit_fire: Prescribe a start adjacent to the fire barrier on the SAFE side so the demo teaches skirting the hazard, not crossing it.
reasoning_implications.wall_thrashing: Prescribe a start away from the boundary so the demo emphasises interior progress toward the goal.
reasoning_implications.timeout: Prescribe a single direct fire-free corridor from start to goal (no oscillation).
reasoning_implications.workspace_constraint: Every prescribed layout MUST keep start, goal, and the 3 fires as DISTINCT in-grid cells in [0..4]^2, with start != goal, Manhattan(start,goal) >= 4, and a fire-free BFS path from start to goal (fires never block all routes). Out-of-grid or unsolvable layouts are rejected and waste the round.
reasoning_implications.non_emptiness: A failure is present, so the prescription MUST be a concrete, fully-specified layout (non-empty start, goal, fire cells). Never emit an empty prescription.
